ph.quote: * **pH: 5.57** – text: Control (NaCl), Treatment1 (KCl) and Treatment2 were 5.6, 5.6 and 5.5, table 5.57a

ammonia.reason: Low proteolysis/deamination in young base plus NH3 stripped during cooking.

animal_barnyard.reason: Pasteurized, no Brevibacterium p-cresol/indole/skatole barnyard compounds.

bitter.reason: Young, low hydrophobic peptides and Ca-chelation by citrate/phosphate masks bitterness.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti; no C7/C9/C11 methyl ketones formed.

browning.reason: Limited Maillard due to low residual lactose/whey and short high-heat exposure.

buttery.reason: Starter-derived diacetyl/acetoin from Cheddar base plus milkfat retained through emulsification.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Low butyric/hexanoic acids from young Cheddar lipolysis, partly volatilized at 84C cook.

creaminess.reason: Sodium citrate/phosphate emulsification of 31.8% fat into smooth homogeneous matrix.

crumbliness.reason: Plasticized processed casein with no aged crystal/curd junctions to fracture.

firmness.reason: High moisture 39.6% and emulsified casein network give soft sliceable body.

floral_honey.reason: Trace phenylacetaldehyde/phenylethanol only; no floral starter or pasture terpenes.

fruity.reason: Very low ethyl butanoate/hexanoate; young curd plus heating limits esterase esterification.

goaty.reason: No goat milk caproic/caprylic/capric branched acids; cow milk only.

malty_nutty.reason: Minimal Strecker 2-/3-methylbutanal from short-aged base and heat-denatured enzymes.

melt.reason: Emulsifying salts deflocculate casein and hydrate paracasein for uniform flow without curdling.

oil_off.reason: Phosphate/citrate emulsification binds free fat, preventing oiling despite 31.8% fat.

smoky.reason: Unsmoked formulation; no guaiacol/syringol from smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic/acetic acid from starter, pH 5.57 gives mild tang without sharp vinegar.

stretch.reason: No aligned pasta-filata paracasein fibers; melt flows viscously rather than strings.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Heat-induced whey protein sulfhydryls/H2S from 84C pasteurization-cook of curd blend.

sweet.reason: Residual lactose/carbohydrate ~3.7% plus diacetyl/lactones give faint sweet-milk note.

umami.reason: Modest glutamate peptides from ~20-day Cheddar base enhanced by Na-phosphate/citrate salts.
